errors.title: Gateway Timeout
errors.description: Upstream API gateway timed out awaiting response from downstream microservice within deadline
recommended_actions: Enable circuit breaker on downstream calls

errors.title: Internal Server Error
errors.description: Backend microservice encountered an unhandled runtime exception while processing request
probable_causes: Null pointer dereference in business logic
Out of memory error in container
recommended_actions: Inspect application error traces in logs

errors.title: Database Connection Pool Exhausted
errors.description: All connections in the database pool are checked out, causing incoming queries to block and time out
probable_causes: Connection leak in transactional code block
Surge in concurrent HTTP traffic exceeding max_conns
recommended_actions: Audit connection checkout duration and ensure connections close in finally blocks

errors.title: Database Pool Saturated
errors.description: Database pool utilization exceeded 80% of configured maximum connections
probable_causes: Sub-optimal database indexing causing slow queries
